preconditions: VidMan_Init (0x004FA320) is invoked once from Game_Init (0x0042D6B0) during subsystem setup; the packet's graph context lists this single caller.
VidMan_Post (0x004FAC00) is invoked from Game_Post (0x0042DA30) during subsystem teardown.

The config globals consumed by VidMan_Init (dword_7CFB90 rendering-mode selector, dword_7CF65C shadow-map config, dword_7CFBFC/dword_7CFC20 rendering flags, dword_7D032C audio flag, dword_7CE5EC/dword_7CE5D0 path settings, dword_8AC48C/dword_8AC490 scene record) are already initialized by the caller.
The texture object init (0x004DCBA0) and FPS HUD widget init (0x004F8D70) assume a non-null this pointer from their callers.
The pit-crew path builder (0x004DDAD0) returns immediately when its first argument a1 is NULL.
0x004F8D70 is called once from the game frame loop entry sub_4FA7E0.
postconditions: VidMan_Init returns 0 on success: the audio engine has been initialized against dword_8AFE88, the render/init callback sub_4F9480 has run once with the opaque parameter 1120534528, and a subsystem-initialized flag bit has been set.
VidMan_Init returns 1 on audio engine initialization failure, after writing the 'CUBE error loading scene file' log line.
VidMan_Post returns the StringMatchWithFlagSet result after registering the trimmed scene directory path, or 0 when no scene record is active (396 * dword_8AC48C + dword_8AC490 == 0).

The texture object init returns 1 when either D3D texture creation or the fallback constructor succeeds (ResourceCleanup runs again before return), and 0 otherwise; on the failure path it stores a2/a7/a8 at this+0x1C/this+0x14/this+0x18 and runs PositionComputationWithAlignment.
The pit-crew path builder registers the 9 texture-type path candidates (indices 0..8) and frees all temporary string buffers and the lookup handle before returning.
The FPS HUD widget is marked active (this+0x0 = 2) only when both the Font.MAS lookup and the FTFRAMERATE.BMP surface load succeed; it always returns 0.
side_effects: Registers the render/init callback sub_4F9480 via sub_546230(sub_4F9480, 1090519040) and later clears it with sub_546230(0, 0).
Initializes the audio engine via AudioEngineInitialization(&dword_8AFE88, trackPath, 0); VidMan_Post releases and nulls dword_8AFE88.
Registers season and track directory path strings with StringRegistry from VidMan_Init.
VidMan_Post resets the frame-rate counter dword_8AFCA8 and registers the trimmed scene directory path.

The texture object init allocates a 96-byte zero-filled child object stored at this[1], ORs bit 0 into its dword at +0x44, registers/removes a linked-list node via sub_53CBC0/sub_53CE40, and reruns ResourceCleanup on success.
The pit-crew path builder allocates and frees a 256-byte path buffer and a lookup handle, and resolves 9 texture paths through TextureAdjuster (0x004DC770).
The FPS HUD widget allocates and constructs a 76-byte backing sub-object (sub_556220), registers a font path string, and loads Font.MAS / FTFRAMERATE.BMP assets.
Reads screen-resolution globals dword_8B8DD4/dword_8B8DD8 to derive FPS HUD layout values.

external_dependencies.name: CRT string routines (strlen; strcpy-style byte copies; '%s%s' formatting)

disputes.description: The five functions share the bootstrap wave and several call families (sub_53CBC0/sub_53CE40/sub_87C03) but not a proven owner class. VideoManager, FrameRateHudWidget, PitCrewTexturePathsBuilder and TextureRenderObject are DERIVED labels from raw-C behavior, not reconciled ownership.

Packet functions use mixed conventions: 0x004DCBA0 and 0x004F8D70 are __thiscall, 0x004DDAD0 is __fastcall, and 0x004FA320/0x004FAC00 are unlabeled no-argument routines (MSVC default cdecl, unproven). The contract records 'unknown' and documents the per-function labels here.
texture_object, texture_child_object, pitcrew_paths_builder and fps_hud_widget are provisional object names for offset anchoring; no two objects here are proven to share a single type.

The scene record layout assumed by VidMan_Init/VidMan_Post (stride 396 per dword_8AC48C index, path string at record+4) is a DERIVED interpretation, not confirmed by the packet.
Opaque parameters 1090519040 (sub_546230) and 1120534528 (sub_4F9480) are kept as decimal literals; their semantic meaning is unverified.
In 0x004FA320 the trailing-backslash strip v15[v10 + 511] is a decompiler alias artifact: v16 aliases v15 + 512, so the strip applies to the formatted v16 season path, not the track-directory buffer.
The backslash byte 92 tail-trim implements Windows path-directory extraction in 0x004FA320, 0x004FAC00 and 0x004DDAD0; other path separator conventions are not handled.
Arguments a2 and a3 of 0x004F8D70 are unused in the body; their caller semantics are unknown.
The purpose of the sub_556260(1) one-argument call in 0x004F8D70 is unresolved.
The font/surface constants 0xFFFFFF, 64 and 0x20000 passed to FontSurfaceLookupDispatch/sub_53CFE0 are unresolved.
The semantics of sub_5665B0, sub_53CBC0 and sub_53C800 (string append / lookup-handle build / string registry) are derived from usage only.
TextureAdjuster's return selector is consumed only for texture index 0; its semantics are not documented by this packet.
The meaning of the pit-crew path builder's this+972/this+984 config strings and of the owning object is inferred, not independently evidenced.
The 9-candidate v50 structure (up to three (path, selector) candidate pairs per texture type) is an interpretation of the raw C, not a confirmed struct layout.

Mixed calling conventions across the packet (thiscall 0x004DCBA0/0x004F8D70, fastcall 0x004DDAD0, unlabeled 0x004FA320/0x004FAC00) mean no single signature represents the whole packet; the recorded signature is the primary lifecycle entry role only.
tests_required: Verify VidMan_Init returns 0 after a clean AudioEngineInitialization and that the subsystem-initialized flag bit is set.
Verify VidMan_Init returns 1 and logs the 'CUBE error loading scene file' line when AudioEngineInitialization fails.
Verify VidMan_Post registers the trimmed scene directory path via StringMatchWithFlagSet and nulls dword_8AFE88.
Verify the 9 pit-crew texture candidate paths (indices 0..8) are registered and that all temporary buffers are freed after 0x004DDAD0.
Verify the FPS HUD widget is only marked active (this+0x0 = 2) when both the Font.MAS lookup and the FTFRAMERATE.BMP surface load succeed.
Verify the texture object init returns 1 on success and 0 on failure, and that the failure path stores a2/a7/a8 at this+0x1C/0x14/0x18.
